overview: The Katta Garrison is the Loyalist Legion’s command center, responsible for military coordination, training, and enforcement of Senate directives.
history: Constructed after the Loyalist schism to establish a disciplined military command.
Expanded with fortified barracks and tactical planning halls.
Arcane stabilizers were added to reinforce defensive wards.
The Garrison became the central hub for Legion command and elite training.
hooks: A Senate directive requires immediate mobilization of elite units.
A tactical officer reports unusual arcane interference in the command hall.
A training accident reveals sabotage within the Garrison.
A Legion envoy arrives with classified orders.
